cases.explain: Моисей is the indirect object of сказал (said to whom), which takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: То завтра я наведу на твою ___ саранчу.
cases.translation: …then tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country.
cases.explain: The preposition на with direction takes the accusative; feminine nouns in -а end in -у in the accusative.

cases.translation: By morning the wind brought the locusts.
cases.explain: саранча is the direct object of принес; feminine nouns in -а end in -у in the accusative.

cases.translation: It will cover the surface of the land.
cases.explain: поверхность (surface) governs a following noun in the genitive: the surface of the land.

cases.translation: Moses stretched out his staff over Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition над (over/above) always governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Чтобы ты мог потом рассказать ___ и внукам.
cases.translation: …that you may afterward tell your children and grandchildren.
cases.explain: рассказать кому (tell to whom) governs the dative; here the dative plural детям.

cases.sentence: Деревья, которые растут у вас в ___.
cases.translation: …the trees that grow for you in the fields.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case; here the prepositional plural.

cases.sentence: А у израилетян, там, где они жили, был ___.
cases.translation: But the Israelites had light where they lived.
cases.explain: свет is the subject of был, so it takes the nominative, the dictionary form.

reading.ru: Моисей повернулся и ушел от фараона.
reading.question: What did Moses do after delivering the warning?
reading.explain: The text says Moses turned and went out from Pharaoh.

reading.question: What did the wind bring by morning?
reading.explain: The text says by morning the wind brought the locusts.

reading.ru: Она покрыла всю землю так, что земля почернела.
reading.question: What did the locusts do to the land?
options: Covered it so it turned black
reading.correct: Covered it so it turned black
reading.explain: The text says the locusts covered the whole land so that it turned black.

reading.ru: Господь переменил ветер на очень сильный морской ветер, который подхватил саранчу и унес в Красное море.
reading.question: How were the locusts removed?
options: A strong sea wind carried them into the Red Sea
They flew back to the east
reading.correct: A strong sea wind carried them into the Red Sea
reading.explain: The text says Yahweh changed the wind to a strong sea wind that swept the locusts into the Red Sea.

reading.ru: Наисей поднял руку к небу, и непроницаемая тьма покрыла Египет на три дня.
reading.question: How long did the darkness cover Egypt?
reading.explain: The text says an impenetrable darkness covered Egypt for three days.

reading.ru: А у израилетян, там, где они жили, был свет.
reading.question: What did the Israelites have during the darkness?
reading.explain: The text says the Israelites had light where they lived.
